tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Ivory in light; Ink Black in dark.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, form fields sitting on surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Alternate section bands, table header rows, footer.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headlines on surface (16.5:1), surface-sunk (14.8:1), sand (13:1). In light it is the brand colour itself.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, disclosures on surface (6.9:1), surface-sunk (6.1:1), sand (5.4:1); dark 7.2:1+.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Ink Black. Hero bands, nav bar, primary buttons, logo ground. Text on it is on-brand; secondary text on it is on-brand-muted. Dark theme lifts it so the band reads against the Ink Black page.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and logo on a brand fill (16.5:1).

tokens.name: on-brand-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on a brand fill (8.6:1).

tokens.name: camel
tokens.usage: Accent fill: rules, the logo's second word on Ink Black, one highlight per view, accent text on brand bands (6.3:1). Decorative only on light surfaces (2.6:1): never text, never the sole carrier of meaning there.

tokens.name: camel-text
tokens.usage: Camel as text on light surfaces: labels, links on surface (6.3:1), surface-sunk (5.6:1), sand (5.0:1). Dark 7.1:1+.

tokens.name: on-camel
tokens.usage: Text on a camel fill (6.3:1). Never white on camel (2.9:1).

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Soft tint for callout panels. Text on it is ink, ink-muted or camel-text.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules and card borders, 1px. Lines, not shadows.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Positive performance figures only; always with a + sign or label.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Losses and errors only; always with a – sign or label.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset (camel-text value so it clears 3:1 on light).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card inner gaps, form rows.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gutters.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between page sections on desktop; halve on mobile.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Section bands, images, tables. The default: the brand is square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and callout panels, the most rounding allowed.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Level 0, the default. Page sections, cards, tables and panels: flat, separated by a 1px line border.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Level 1. Only the sticky nav bar once the page has scrolled, so it lifts off content. Nothing else.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Level 2. Floating layers: dropdown menus, popovers, tooltips, date pickers. Pair with a 1px line border.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Level 3. Modal dialogs (e.g. accredited-investor verification), shown over an Ink Black scrim at 60% opacity. The maximum; never stack two.
